nom: Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser Face Wash for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: When I say I love this cleanser, it is an understatement. For tears I have tried cleanser after cleanser and to finally find one that smells clean, rinses clean, and isn't harsh on my sensitive skin. I keep bottles stocked so I never run out.

avis.titre: Better than any oil I've tried
avis.texte: This has surpassed my holy grail oil cleanser from D** brand. Ive tried seversl balms and oils and many didnt work well to rinse clean and actually take off my makeup. I glam every day so I need to double cleanse. This has become my HOLY GRAIL first step to double cleansing. I am acne prone and i havent expereinced any break outs since using this either. My skin is very sensitive and will react dramatically with products that are too harsh. However, I haven't experienced any burning, rashes or redness with this product. It doesnt strip my face dry however it does rinse clean (for an oil) i like how it works into a lather that sucks up all the makeup as you're rubbing it in. So you're basically creating a layer of makeup lather over your skin then your rinse away and it's clean! The makeup is gone and your skin is left clear and ready for your normal cleanser. I hope this never gets discontinued.

This Cetaphil oil to foam cleanser is perfect for dry or sensitive skin. Starts as a silky oil, turns into a gentle foam, and leaves my face soft instead of tight and squeaky. It is being used morning and night end sometimes vern a top up during the day . Will continue to use this . I think it has been a great find and purchase

This product has done WONDERS for my skin. I struggle with severe dry patches, and some spots being oily and this has been a godsend to me!! This has helped my skin in so many ways and because it's fragrance free my sensitive skin has been LOVING it!!

Minimal to no scent and nice thick texture. I feel like using this as part of my double cleanse routine, really gets my skin clean after a full day of makeup! I don't use it on my eyes, but it does well removing makeup everywhere else. It gives my skin so much hydration and keeps it from getting dried out. Highly recommend!!
product is okay. does clean well. I like Palmers oil cleanser better as it does a great job removing eye make up without irritating my eyes.

I really enjoy the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser. It has a unique texture that starts like a silky oil and turns into a soft foam when mixed with water. It cleans my skin well, removes daily makeup and sunscreen, but doesn't leave my face feeling tight or dry. My skin feels soft and comfortable after washing, not stripped. I like that it's fragrance-free and gentle, which makes it a great option for sensitive or dry skin. It feels nourishing and helps keep my skin barrier balanced. A nice everyday cleanser, especially during colder months when my skin needs extra hydration.

This is one of my essentials when it comes to my night time skin routine. If you don't have a makeup remover, this is a great dupe! It's not harsh at all and a great oil cleanser before you use your normal cleanser!

avis.titre: Really good but see my last note.
avis.texte: I really liked this cleanser. I felt like I got a comprehensive clean, deep in my pores from the oil and then no residue from the foaming cleanser aspect. My skin never felt stripped or oily. I thought it was the perfect balance. Unfortunately, I noticed something a bit unsettling. I unscrewed the pump nozzle to get the last few drops out of the bottom and noticed this brown liquid inside the pump component where the spring is located. I don't know why this part is so discolored but I don't like it. How long has it been like that? And is it coming out when I pump and I'm putting that on my face? I was going to repurchase this but now I'm really hesitant.

This product is good. It feels organic to me, it has no smell, and I feel like it's good for the skin. The only thing is that i dont have consistent with it. I don't use it regulary. But when i am consistent my skin honestly feels clean. Also , i think the packaging is cute. I feel like the pink color suits us well. I really like it. And i would love to become more consistentwith this product ! Thanks !

avis.titre: This cleanser feels gentle on my skin and removes makeup ...
avis.texte: I love how this cleanser starts as an oil and turns into a soft foam. It cleans my face really well without making my skin feel dry or tight. It's gentle enough for everyday use and leaves my skin smooth and refreshed.
Great fragrance free lightweight oil to foam cleanser is great and gentle on the skin. Foams well and need a little amount . Packaging is basic and simple.

Super thin liquid and not my fave at all. I have oily to normal skin and this stripped all the moisture out of my face. Left me feeling tight and dry. I did not like it sadly. However the plus side of this product is it will take off all your makeup and your mascara!

avis.titre: It cleans your skin really well without stripping it .
avis.texte: Honestly,o didn't expect much but I really like it .the texture starts like an oil and the turns into a light foam ,wich feel super nice on my skin .it cleanse well without leaving my face dry or tight ,especially when my skin feels sensitive .the bottle is simple with a pump .easy to use ,and it last because I don't need a lot .i used it pretty much every day ,mostly at night,and it just leaves my skin soft and comfortable.

I really love this new oil to foam cleanser as it's very gentle and leaves my skin feeling hydrated after use. You don't need too much product and I think it works pretty well at removing my sunscreen at the end of the day. There is no scent and I love the size of this bottle. It's a great price for the amount you're getting and love the pump packaging.

Not a bad cleanser. Have been using it for a few weeks. Haven't experienced any breakouts. I do wake up with soft skin instead of feeling dry. It does remove ALL my makeup. The price isn't bad and I like that it's a pump dispenser. It doesn't feel super oily like some oil cleansers.

I have used gentle cetaphil wash for years. I tried this new product with high hopes. It removes makeup and makes your skin feel very clean. But for some reason, it broke my skin out HORRIBLY. To be fair, I have very sensitive skin. So if you are acne prone with sensitive skin this is not for you. I'm on month three of detoxing from this cleanser and my skin is improving but I am still suffering the pain of inflamed acne from how much this cleanser has clogged my pores. :(

This Cetaphil cleansers is one of the best cleansers that I have tried! It doesn't have a strong scent and the consistency of the product is great! The packaging is great as well, it gives you just the perfect amount with only 1 pump. It's super great for sensitive skin and does not leave any residue on my skin.

It's "okay." There's other drugstore brands with more hydrating cleansers than this. Like I said it's comfortable to use and it does not strip the skin but it doesn't leave it super moisturized or hydrated either. I would not purchase again.

avis.titre: Great after a cleansing balm, but not my fave on its own
avis.texte: I was on the hunt for cleanser for the winter time when my skin is a lot more dry and prone to flaking. And this has been doing a great job at not drying my skin after a cleansing balm. However, I did notice when I use this alone, I get tightness around my eyes and mouth which are my more eczema prone areas. I have never broken out into a reaction but just something I noticed. When I have flare ups on my hands, this doesn't exacerbate the issue, which is a bonus, but I know reactions are unique from person to person so just bc I don't react to it, doesn't mean it will do the same for all people. Overall, it was a great addition to my winter routine but not something I would use without using a cleansing balm first.

I've been using this since September and it's actually really good. I like the texture and it really gets all of the gunk and makeup off my face after 2 washes. One other thing that is actually super helpful for me is that its really good for getting hair dye out of skin. I've had blue hair for a while now and this is the soap that gets it out the most when I get it on my hands. I've used other soaps specifically meant for hair dye but they always destroy my skin and dry me out a lot, but this is gentle enough to where I can wash my hands 5 times and they still feel okay!! Great product.

This cleanser is different than I've ever used before. It starts out as an oil (quite loose oil) and when you mix it with a little bit of water it lathers up to a foam. I have dry skin and this doesn't strip my natural oils away. And rinses clean but not squeaky clean. More like a moisturized clean.
I love this product! I've been using it for 6 months and my skin looks sooo good. I recommend it to anyone. It's not sticky at all and the package is so easy.
I used a sample of this and seems like im allergic to something in this wash. My face completely broke out. It might work for you but didnt for me.

This cleanser has become my daily cleanser after trying Vanicream, Prequel, LRP, Cerave, Cetaphil... It cleans my oily combo skin super well but doesn't dry it out, yet is great for my adapelene-sensitized skin. No breakouts, no clogged pores, no irritation. And it removes makeup! PLEASE make this in a bigger size. I use it as body wash too! Amazing

Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam cleanser has genuinely made my life easier. I'd fallen into the whole double cleansing routine. Which worked great, but I'm tired at the end of the day, and sometimes I'd honestly rather go to bed with makeup on than wash my face twice. So when I saw an ad for this cleanser, I ordered it immediately, and I'm so glad I did. After a few weeks of use, I can confidently say I'm a fan. It removes all makeup and cleanses in one step, which has made my nighttime skin care routine much more consistent. My skin feels cleansed without feeling tight or dry. There's no oily residue left behind, no overpowering fragrance, and it rinses off easily. Packaging is effective. Not fancy but fine. If you're a double cleansing gal looking to simplify your routine, this is a must.

This product is absolutely wonderfu!It does not leave your skin feeling oily at all. It just cleans your face without drying your skin out it works amazing on sensitive skin. Will definitely keep purchasing this 💜

This product caused my skin to purge. It started slowly, but after a week of using this product my face was covered in painful acne & its been WEEKS since! I keep struggling with break outs & my skin is not back to normal.
Amazing used it for the first time so foaming love the texture great for sensitive skin works amazing for oily skin and to remove make up. I love the value for the product .

avis.titre: Great face wash, clean feeling without drying.
avis.texte: I love this face wash. The foam really cleans my skin and doesn't dry me out like other face washes. I use this in the shower and the oil helps to create a good lather and remove all makeup.

avis.titre: Removes your makeup while cleansing your face
avis.texte: No scent, gets all my makeup out with a clean face left behind. Absolutely love love this would definitely recommend in fact all of cetaphil products are amazing
Cetaphil oil to foam cleanser is perfect for dry skin. The oil add moisture to the skin while the foam cleans. The bottle is easy to use and the scent is standard. It's a good overall cleanser.
It foams great and it prevents pimple! My face doesn't feel oily at all and it smells really good! I definitely recommend this product, cetaphil is a great brand

I was looking for an oil cleanser but this just seemed like a normal foaming cleanser. Although it didn't even foam very well lol. My face did not feel very clean after using it and felt like there was still residue. I have sensitive, oily skin.

This was a solid no for me! Followed the instructions, washed my face and eyes. In less than 2 hours my face was burning. I have hypersensitive skin that is very reactive. Been on the hunt for a gentle, fragrance free cleanser. I am not exactly sure what ingredients I am allergic too, but if I had to guess it's the flax seed. I had to go to urgent care to get a steroid shot. My face was red for 4 days from this cleanser.

avis.titre: It's giving HYDRATED, SMOOTHING, AND NOURISHING.
avis.texte: I remember asking someone in our 20s with good skin what they washed their face with & they said soap & water like I wanted a top secret recipe or something. Anyways for Years now I have been invested in using Cetaphil cleansers and moisturizer for my face. Keeping a very minimal facial routine with affordable products. I picked out this specific Cetaphil product recently & it's giving HYDRATED, SMOOTHING, AND NOURISHING. Add this formula to a daily moisturizer Cetaphil please?!! ☆☆☆☆☆ definitely add to your facial routine ✨️ great on it own or use in your double cleanse routine.
Great product. Very gentle on my dry skin. Leaves my skin moisturized.

avis.titre: A gentle cleanser that leaves your skin clean, soft, and ...
avis.texte: I've been using the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser, and I was pleasantly surprised by how gentle it feels on the skin. The scent is light and pleasant, and the oil-to-foam texture makes it easy to rinse off. It cleans thoroughly without leaving the skin tight or dry. It doesn't cause any stinging and leaves the skin feeling fresh and healthy. Perfect for sensitive or dry skin and great for daily use.
Im blown away at how good this cleanser works, feels so good on the skin too, I will be rebuying it!!

I was looking for a substitute for the bareMinerals Smoothness Oil cleanser at a better price point. This cleanser was fine, but it's definitely not an oil. It just felt like regular foaming cleanser to me. I don't know why they call it an oil at all?

I love this face wash. It removes all the makeup including mascara and leaves my skin soft. I also like the fact that it foams really well. It leaves no residue and my skin feels clean, moisturized and fresh.
it smells nice and it's not too harsh on my skin. this made me feel extre clean and i would buy it again. i have already recommended this to my friends and mother.
Loved this product! Loved this product! Loved this product! Loved this product! Loved this product!
I admire it no breakouts that's what I was worrying about the most !! It really gets the job done as someone who wears alot of maker definitely a must have in my routine

Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser (for oily to normals skin) is my everyday cleanser so when I saw this new oil to foam cleanser I decided to give it a go in hopes that it'll remove my waterproof mascara. It did exactly that! It removes my Maybelline Waterproof Falsies Mascara, which can be pretty stubborn if you're not using a cleansing oil. I'm so happy with this find and absolutely love and recommend it! It works best for me when I use it like a cleansing oil and apply it to dry skin and then use water to massage and rinse it off.
I love this!! This gets the makeup off completely all the way. I love how soft it makes my skin feel, especially with colder weather coming it definitely keeps skin moisturized!
This product has helped my skin clear a little. It has also softened and made my skin feeling and looking extra glowy. I feel super clean after washing my face with this.
Works in my sensitive skin. Cleans enough without striping and feels nice and fresh when I'm done. Not heavy no residue just a simple face wash. takes off my makeup with ease

avis.titre: Not foamy and doesn't clean well
avis.texte: I don't know how this has the best of reviews. It barely foams. It doesn't feel like it's cleaning anything and I was right because I went over with a pad and micellar water. I had tons of spf still on my skin regardless of washing twice and massaging for a couple of minutes. It also burned my eyes pretty badly. Not a huge fan.
Awesome face wash. Super basic but perfect for simple needs. Washes my face great and it's comfortable to use. Perfect consistency. Scent is barely noticeable. Packaging is simple and realistic

Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser It starts as a silky oil that melts away makeup and sunscreen. then it turns into a gentle foam that leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. My face feels soft, smooth, and hydrated after every wash. Perfect for daily use.
Cetaphil's Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser takes off makeup and sunscreen easily without drying my skin, and it leaves it feeling soft. It works well for dry or sensitive skin, very gentle!

This cleanser feels great. It starts of as a oil/gel and once you wet it lathers up to a great foam. My skin feels so clean and hydrated when i use it. And i love that it has a pump makes it easier to use.
Such a good everyday cleanser that has removed all my makeup on the first try. Doesn't feel too drying and comes out so slick. Packaging is cute and love the colors, no strong scent or anything.
I really love how smooth this cleanser applies! The best part honestly for me is how it doesn't smell bad! I'm hooked, it keeps me feeling fresh and clean!

avis.titre: Soft, Hydrated, and Clean in One Step
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser! The texture is so unique,it starts as a silky oil that melts away makeup, sunscreen, and dirt, then turns into a light foam when you add water. It makes cleansing feel gentle but effective at the same time. What I appreciate most is how soft and hydrated my skin feels after using it. Unlike many cleansers that leave my face tight or dry, this one actually makes my skin feel nourished and smooth. It's fragrance-free, very gentle, and perfect for my sensitive skin. Even after daily use, my skin barrier feels protected and calm. The pump is convenient, a little goes a long way, and it's great for both morning and night. For me, this cleanser is the perfect balance between effective cleansing and skin care. It's definitely a new staple in my routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet powerful cleanser!
I like this face cleanser. It is light and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or leaves a residue. It has a slight scent but not too strong. The pump works nice too

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. If we can start with the packaging! The bottle itself is cute, very descriptive and they are not stingy about the amount! The price is phenomenally affordable and the product itself is top notch amazing quality! A little bit does go along ways! You literally only need half of one pump I promise! There's not really a scent, but I can promise you that your skin will feel absolutely clean and look even cleaner! I am so happy with this product we went and got another bottle for my daughter. She loves how quick and easy very effortlessly removes her makeup while ensuring her skin looks and feels clean!

This facial wash is gentle on your skin. It works well if you have combination skin such as oily and dry or oily and sensitive. It lathers well leaving a clean feeling. The bottle is easy to store in the shower.

I absolutely love the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser. It takes all of my makeup off easily and does such a good job at cleaning at my face. Lathers very well and my face feels so clean and refreshed after using. No scent

I've been using the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser for a few weeks now, and overall, I'm really happy with it. It goes on as a light oil but quickly foams up when you add water, which makes it feel gentle yet effective.I mostly use it at night, and it does a great job. Has almost like a bubble gum scent but not strong
This cleansing oil is great to remove makeup. I love how my skin gets hydrated and clean after use. One good point that I also love is the fact that is fragrance free.

I like this as a basic cleanser. It removes my makeup without feeling harsh or burning my eyes. I don't think it makes that much foam but I would say it is hydrating as an oil cleaner. Not slimy but my skin feels smooth.

The Cetaphil Oil to Foam Cleanser starts as a light oil and transforms into a soft foam that removes makeup and dirt easily. It cleans thoroughly without stripping the skin, leaving it feeling fresh and balanced. Perfect for daily use, especially for sensitive or combination skin.

The packaging is simple, easy and basic which is nice. The scent is almost nonexistent but has a mild clean doctors office smell, I really like it plus it's a foam like texture so you're not getting oil everywhere. I would say it works well for my sensitive skin

avis.titre: Hyper Sensitive skin safe & it's affordable!
avis.texte: 10/10 love this product! Doesn't have a scent as it is fragrance free but that's perfect for those with hyper sensitive skin! I've noticed over the month of using this product my pores have become smaller and I'm having less harsher breakouts. I'm on several medicines and my hormones normally have me having awful cystic acne or skin flare ups and using certain I've noticed increased healing and tightness. Overall I love this product and will continue to use and buy again and again! Definitely my new skincare holy grail! 😊

avis.titre: a gentle yet effective option for daily cleansing
avis.texte: Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser is a gentle yet effective option for daily cleansing, especially for those with dry or sensitive skin. It starts as a light oil that dissolves makeup, sunscreen, and excess sebum, then transforms into a soft foam when mixed with water, leaving the skin feeling clean but not stripped. The formula is fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, and enriched with nourishing oils that help maintain the skin's natural moisture barrier, making it a great choice for anyone who wants a thorough cleanse without irritation or tightness.
I love using this cleanser after a long day of wearing makeup. Removes makeup effectively. Formulated with Flaxseed Oil & Pentavitin leaving my skin nourished.
I have combo, sensitive skin. This doesn't have a harsh scent or irritate my skin. I use it as part of my double cleanse routine. It foams nicely and gets the job done!

I received this cleanser through Influenster and Cetaphil in exchange for my honest review. I love this cleanser, gets rid of all the make up and build up on my face. This cleanser is very soft and gentle on the face but doesn't leave any residue or product left on my face. I would recommend 100%

I have very dry skin and this cleanser leaves my skin clean and EASILY washes off makeup and leaves my skin feeling nourished and fresh. This cleanser is gentle but does a great job at cleansing your skin. I love the price point too. The smell isn't pungent nor nasty it has a subtle clean scent. Overall I love it!

Cetaphil products rarely disappoint. This cleanser is a no nonsense cleanser which does its job perfectly. Fragrance free (although it does have a slight chemical smell), removes dirt and makeup without stripping the skin and is super hydrating. It says its for normal to dry skin but for someone who has oily to combination skin, it works great on my skin as well. I look forward to using it more in the coming cold weather.
Perfect to cleanse and take off makeup. No burning of the eyes or greasy feeling once you wash it off. All of my makeup was gone! No crazy scents or difficult to use packaging.
Cleanser that leaves you feeling squeaky clean and fresh! I was initially concerned when it said it starts as an oil but it's not what you think! It definitely is perfect for what I need

Lets try this new oil to foam cleanser! The first time I used it I had waterproof makeup on and it took it away very easily! It is great for sensitive skin and in my experience having oily skin it doesn't feel oily at all. I even feel it a little bit too deep cleansing, leaving your skin with a tight feeling. It doesn't have any smell so people with allergies to fragrances are going to love it! It is a definitely a must have. 9/10

avis.titre: Great for double cleansing, really saw a difference
avis.texte: I'm always so nervous when trying new skincare because my skin is super sensitive, but this worked wonders for me! My nose gets super oily and breakouts there were painful, but this helped to clear them up when double cleansing.
Descent is soft. It works really well and ensures. My skin is very soft and bouncy. The texture is great. The packaging is really cute and I really like the ingredients in the oil

I received this face wash free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this cleanser almost daily, and I really like how gentle it feels on my skin. It starts as a lightweight oil and then softens into a mild, milky foam once I add water, which makes removing my makeup and sunscreen easier. I have really dry skin, and it doesn't leave me feeling stripped or dry; instead, my skin feels hydrated and refreshed afterward. The texture is smooth and easy to work with, and I appreciate that it rinses off without leaving residue behind. I love that it doesn't have a strong, overpowering scent. It didn't irritate my skin at all. The pump is convenient and mess-free, which makes it easy to use, even on busy nights. It dispenses just the right amount of soap. I highly recommend this wash! ✨
I love the oil to foam texture! It does feel like a high end product but for a fraction of the price. I love this cleanser and am so happy I got to try it!

avis.titre: Gentle and effective for daily cleaning
avis.texte: I tried the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser and was surprised by how gentle it was on my skin. I have combination skin with an oily T-zone, and this cleanser removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily dirt without leaving my skin feeling tight or greasy. It starts as a light oil and transforms into a soft foam upon contact with water. It feels very comfortable to apply and rinses off easily. I like that it contains flaxseed oil, known for its soothing and nourishing properties. It also has no added fragrance, making it ideal if you're sensitive to perfumes.

avis.titre: Great wash for evening and night
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser and the fact that it is so gentle with my skin. It has no scent and it's easy to use and washes off well. And it leaves my skin nice and hydrated afterwards.

avis.titre: Great for normal to dry skin!
avis.texte: Very happy with this product! Love that it starts as an oil and then gets really foamy! It foams up nice om the skin! I prefer an oil cleanser because I feel like I'm able to get it into my skin easier than a cream or lotion. The foam melts into the skin, and with some water, turns foamy! I'm able to really emulsify the product into the skin! This product is ideal for anyone with normal to dryer skin - and has left my skin moisturized & hydrated! I love that the product feels light on my skin & not heavy, fragrance is neutral, and product leaves no residue on the skin! This product dosles a good job at removing makeup, dirt/excess oil & sebum without being too stripping or drying. Love Cetaphil products!!
Easy to use packaging, the cleanser felt great on the skin and felt like my skin got a deeper clean. Little to no scent and very good ingredients to make sure your face is nice and nourished

I think it's more of a oil cleanser than a cleanser. I never felt like it truly took off my makeup until I went in with a different cleanser, but it's still good for what it is. It's thick and suds up well, other than that. No complaints.

I have been using the new Cetaphil nourishing oil to foam cleanser in my skincare routine for a few weeks and I'm really enjoying it. It leaves my face feeling soft, doesn't have a scent and does not irritate my face. I will continue using this product and purchasing it when im done with it. I recommend anybody who has sensitive skin like me to give it a try.

I'm liking this product so far…. There is no scent… light texture, thought it says oil cleanser, didn't feel like one…. Not a whole lot of lather but still does the job… no breakouts from it either. I did feel my face a bit dry after washes…

I really liked it. It made my skin feel so smooth and hydrated. It definitely does seem like an oil at first and then it changes to foam as you're working into your skin. It doesn't leave no type of residue either
This feels amazing on the skin! It doesn't break me out at all and as an acne prone girly it's so helpful. I recommend this to everyone, especially if you're oily
I love that the cleanser has no smell! It definitely foams up and leaves your skin feeling clean and moisturized. It also leaves no oily film on your face.
This cleanser is amazing. The ingredients having flaxseed and other natural ingredients is amazing for a skincare cleanser. No scent. Works smoothingly! There is no complaints on this cleanser

Cetaphil Oil to Foam Cleanser. The name is a bit misleading. Because its not exactly a oil cleanser. at least, not in the way you would think. It's actually more like a soap. It doesn't feel like oil, the consistency feels very thin. it's not greasy. Its a very gentle cleanser that leaves my skin clean and hydrated. It does a good job removing excess oils and makeup. A perfect addition to my nightly routine. This cleanser has no scent to it, very hydrating and isn't clogging. It is best used as a second step when removing makeup to ensure your face is completely clean.

I love Cetaphil products in general so I knew I would love this product! It has sturdy packaging, clean ingredients and the oil isn't sticky or slimy feeling. It cleans my face very well and removes makeup and impurities with ease! 10/10 recommend!

Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser has been a pleasant surprise in my skincare routine. It starts off as a silky oil that melts away sunscreen and light makeup, then turns into a gentle foam that rinses off easily. My skin feels clean but never dry or tight afterward, which is rare for my sensitive, combination skin. It's fragrance-free and doesn't clog pores, which I appreciate. It might not remove heavy makeup completely, but as a daily cleanser, it does the job well. If you're looking for something gentle and hydrating, this is definitely worth trying. I'll be repurchasing.

This cleansing oil is not just an oil whenever you are GENTLY rubing it on your face it starts to form a foam kind solution that deeply cleans your pores from makeup and other daily products. It is a good option to have in the shower to use every night before bed :)

Product is great and did not irritate my skin, but I was suspecting way more for my acne which I did not see. I've been using for a couple of weeks. It is a product that is very reflection and the ingredients seem to be safe for skin packaging is beautiful and unique. It is not exaggerating. It is normal. It's not sweet. It is just a normal one, I don't like strong smells on my face, this is great. Also, it is like very foamy so it's kind of hard for me to remove, but it is great I am just the one who doesn't like stuff that is it is like hard to remove. It is not hard, like for me I don't like putting too much work.
I absolutely love using Cetaphil cleanser. Its foam cleanser is great for my oily skin. It feels gentle on the skin and works amazing. The packaging is very user-friendly.

seriously amazing product. it's even gentler than the famous cetaphil dry to sensitive skin cleanser. no residue and it lathers really nicely. i usually use it in the shower before bed so it's not as messy on my counter lol. i love this product definitely gonna buy it again when i run out

I love Cetaphil as a brand so I was excited to try out this new cleanser and it DID NOT DISAPPOINT! A little goes a long way and I love how easy and light it was to put on/wash off. The cleanser has a light scent but nothing overwhelming which I like. Left my skin feeling smooth. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I will definitely keep using it
avis.texte: Great cleanser it has a slight scent to it, it didn't leave an oily feeling and the skin feels very moisturized it was great at removing waterproof makeup and it foams easily

@influenster @cetaphilUS #complimentary #CetaphilNourish use cetaphil nourishing oil to foam cleanser on your skin to wash away any dead skin, oil and grime that gets on your face throughout the day. this effectively cleans your skin without overly drying it out.
I'm very happy with this face wash! It takes off makeup very easily and lathers up nicely to a foam. It doesn't irritate my skin at all and has a pleasant scent :)

Cetaphil's new nourishing oil to foam cleanser is perfect for nights where you are not feeling like using two different cleansers to double cleanse your SPF or makeup off. I love that this cleanser is fragrance free, residue free and does not clog my pores. Instead, it feels very hydrating and I love that in one step I am able to remove dirt and oil off my skin without stripping my natural oils.

Overall I really liked this product, it did really well removing day to day grime as well as full glam makeup. It was gentle on my skin and left it feeling moisturized even after use. Also a little goes a long way so I feel like the product will last a decent amount of time even with daily use. I did have a few nitpicks, to me the scent reminds me of stagnant soapy water, and I didn't love the foaming effect/feel as a whole, but overall this is a product I'd use often and would recommend.
Oil cleansers low-key never worked for me, but this one worked so well. It only took me 20 seconds to take off my makeup and it feels so nice on the skin.

I love this cleanser! Many cleansers leave my skin so dry. With this, I barely noticed ANY dry skin and even forgot to put on my moisturizer! It leaves my skin feeling so clean, and has little to no fragrance which is perfect for anyone with sensitivity.
The scent of this product is clean and the ingredients are also clean. The packaging is cute because it is pink. It effectively removes my makeup with a foamy texture.

I like the normal sensitive skin cetaphil but THIS is so much better. Might become my new go to skin cleanser. Not only is it sensitive skin friendly. The lather is nice but doesn't leave the skin with a residue. Its basically a two step cleanser in 1. Im super impressed.

Absolutely love it! One of the best I own right now that doesn't strip away my skin. Keeps hydration for 24 hours and feels amazing on the skin. I received this product for free through influenster and Cetaphil in exchange for my honest opinion.

I've always loved Cetaphil products, so I was excited to try their Oil to Foam Cleanser. This one is formulated with flax seed oil, which helps to nourish the skin. It starts off as a rich, silky oil that transforms into a gentle foam, providing great coverage. A little goes a long way, making it both effective and long lasting. After using it, my skin felt soft, hydrated, and refreshed and that feeling truly lasted.
Great product, very foamy and great for sensitive skin. No scent, which is a bonus. Always a fan of cetaphil, and their sensitive skin line is great!

I love this cleanser so much!! This unscented cleanser didn't make me breakout and was great for taking my makeup off or to use as a double cleanser step! I definitely recommend this if you are looking for a new great cleanser! It is also the cutest Cetaphil packaging I love it!!

This is a great cleanser for people who tend to get oily skin. It works very well at cleansing the face. It has a light, clean scent. The pump bottle is very easy to use as well. It lathers easily, and rinses off like a breeze. I've loved using this for my nightly face washes after a long day of getting oil build up. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: So soft and smooth, very hydrating and improvement
avis.texte: I really really love this oil to foam cleanser, I love the consistency of it it's so soft and then lathers into a very moisturizing foam it feels so good on my face. Washed my face before bed and immediately saw a difference the very next morning, it's so good! Very little to no fragrance as well. I will continue to buy this product and recommend to everyone!!!

At first use I expecting more of an oil rather than a gel cleanser. This does a good job at removing the sunscreen from my face and I always go in with a second cleanser to double cleanse. After washing my face, despite it being for normal to dry skin and I have oily skin, my skin doesn't feel stripped or tight, it feels nice. It also doesn't break me out despite it having some oils like flaxseed oil which is great.

avis.titre: makes your skin feel very soft !
avis.texte: I love how soft it makes my face feel the flaxseed oils in it really do a wonderful job compared to the ones that don't have it i use this over any of my other face washes, there's not really a scent either which is amazing, the packaging came in GREAT!

I was happy to have received the Cetaphil nourishing oil to foam cleanser to test out. The packaging a cute pink color which stands out. It felt nice to wash my face with this and it didn't feel drying. I would purchase again
I love this cleanser it really does feel a difference when you wash your face if you have an oily part in your face it takes that off and it makes it look vibrant but without the oil.

Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser feels gentle yet effective. It starts as a light oil, then turns into a soft foam that removes makeup and impurities without drying the skin. After use, my skin feels clean, hydrated, and smooth—perfect for daily use, even on sensitive skin.

The Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser has worked well for my skin. It's easy to spread across my face, and the texture starts off like an oil, then it quickly turns into a soft foam. It removes my makeup and excess oils without leaving my skin feeling tight, which is great as my skin is naturally dry. It doesn't leave any residue when I clean it off, and it also leaves skin feeling hydrated and smooth.

Great cleanser for sensitive skin! Nice oily texture that turns into foam immediately and leaves the skin very clean but hydrated. The smell is very neutral so will be perfect for anyone. Packaging with a pump is super convenient.

i love cetaphil the brand in all. This product is great for someone like me who wears sunscreen on a daily and sweats through out the day. I've been using the Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser, and it's quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. What I love most is how it starts as a lightweight oil, which helps melt away makeup and sunscreen, and then transforms into a gentle foam when rinsed with water. It gives me that "deep clean" feeling without stripping my skin or leaving it tight and dry.

avis.titre: Great brand, not the formula for me.
avis.texte: Free product/honest review - I just tried this oil to foam cleanser for a few weeks and I loved the concept of a hydrating face wash. I still needed lotion after using this product, because it left my skin a little dry. Also the oil based formula caused me to break out quite a bit. It seems unscented to me, which I prefer. The texture was smooth and it lathered nicely. The packaging was really cute and I love this brand, so I wanted to love it, but ultimately I would not purchase this, but I would be excited to try other products by Cetaphil in the future.
Loved this cleanser to help remove makeup! Makeup comes off smoothly and leaves skin feeling hydrated and soft. I would definitively recommend!
